scope: Harmonized fixed-specification 2x2 G/P factorial plus standalone G controls. No search, no quota-adjusted two-stage decisions.
pipeline: For both variants within each family: numeric mean imputation -> StandardScaler -> XGBClassifier; model input float64. No categorical features. Same column order, values, dtypes and training partition within family.

additional_current_version_defaults.base_score: Automatic from each training target under installed XGBoost boost_from_average=1; not forced to untrained 0.5

folds: Exact stored outer folds, independently regenerated StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42); inner StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42) within outer training, ascending row order.
P_population: All policy borrowers inside outer training for each variant, not G negatives; each P model/calibrator shared unchanged across both G arms.

calibration.method: LogisticRegression Platt on raw positive probability, not logits
calibration.population: outer-training policy inner OOF scores and labels

thresholds: For each G variant: original finite-threshold first argmax Youden from its training inner OOF. For each P variant: same Youden from its calibrated training policy inner OOF. roc_curve(drop_intermediate=False); >= decisions. No pooled outer-label threshold.
gate: P applied only to the relevant G predicted negatives; all G predicted positives retained; final OR union. Full negative scope only, no optional capacity scenarios.
panel_B: Keep each of four native two-stage masks unchanged. Match standalone tuned G score ranking to its final flag count separately in every fold. Report all four. Secondary same-first-stage G ranking at same budgets also reported and labeled.
rank_tie_rule: Descending standalone G score, ties by ascending original zero-based row_position, no labels. No scalar union ranking.
limitations: Features and tuned parameters preselected, not fully nested selection.
Native thresholds estimated training-only; paired flag-count benchmark uses retrospective test-batch ranking, not prospective fixed thresholds.
Fixed G/P feature sets differ; contrasts isolate vanilla/tuned hyperparameter specifications within each family, not every architecture or domain choice.
Historical Appendix C numerical reproduction and original runtime/fold provenance remain unresolved.
All results descriptive; no significance, operational net benefit, fairness or deployment claim.
feature_source: Preselected KCB2 notebook feature order, frozen before this experiment

portable_runner.difference_from_recorded_execution: Recorded run fitted 90 new models and reused 30 verified Gt models; portable code refits all 120 under the same recipe. Full private-data replay has not been run for this refactor.

publication_scope: Code and configuration only; no empirical result tables or cohort counts are bundled
